formulas.total_costs: crude_oil_and_product_purchases + production_and_manufacturing_expenses + sga + depreciation_and_depletion + exploration_expenses + non_service_pension_expense + interest_expense + other_taxes_and_duties

revenue_yoy.description: Total revenues and other income YoY growth rate vs Q-4

crude_oil_purchases_margin_delta_bps.description: Crude oil and product purchases as % of total revenues, delta vs Q-4

production_manufacturing_margin_delta_bp.description: Production and manufacturing expenses as % of total revenues, delta vs Q-4

sga_margin_delta_bps.description: SG&A as % of total revenues, delta vs Q-4

depreciation_margin_delta_bps.description: Depreciation and depletion as % of total revenues, delta vs Q-4

other_taxes_margin_delta_bps.description: Other taxes and duties as % of total revenues, delta vs Q-4

exploration_expenses_yoy.description: exploration_expenses YoY growth rate vs Q-4

non_service_pension_expense_yoy.description: non_service_pension_expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

interest_expense_yoy.description: interest_expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

income_taxes_abs.description: income_taxes absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

noncontrolling_interests_abs.description: noncontrolling_interests absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
